dog.description_text:
There’s something about Confetti that makes you want to be gentle with the her.

When she walks in a home she will look for you for answers about what was safe and what comes next. Within a few days, she will settle into the rhythm of your life like she was meant to be there. She will follow you from room to room, nap nearby, and look to you from time to time for reassurance that, yes, she is doing fine and everything will be ok.

Confetti is a sweet girl who many be a little shy to begin but within just a few minutes she'll be hamming it up with all involved.

Confetti is also a girl whose happy to move at a chill pace however when she realizes you are spending time with her you'll notice she'll put a bit of pep in her step.

What you'll love most about Confetti is just her desire to belong in a space with you.

Confetti truly doesn’t need much, she's a girl who would love a soft place to land, someone to look to when the world feels uncertain, short walks, long naps, treats, and people who think she’s as funny as she thinks she is.

It will take only a few days for Confetti to be the dog you miss anytime she isn't in the room.

Truly, whoever gets to be her person will be so lucky. She is the most deserving girl and deserves to know a soft, gentle type of love.
dog.name: Confetti
